utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what needs fixing first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’d start with the leaky faucets and broken door latches first—they’re quick wins and keep things safer right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—do we have enough supplies for those, or should I help gather some?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. What do you need first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — tools first. I think we’ll need a wrench set and maybe a screwdriver, if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both — I can bring over a wrench set and a screwdriver. Just tell me where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a nice turnout this week—people seem pretty eager to pitch in. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be great, thanks. I’m just trying to figure out the timing and where everything’s being dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and see when the drop-off windows are open and where they’re setting things up. If I hear anything useful, I’ll come right back to you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you head to the community center and pick up the donation boxes, then bring them back to my porch?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll head to the community center, pick up the donation boxes, and bring them to your porch.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive. Want me to invite a few neighbors and let them know the time and place?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Quinn. Thank you—just keep it simple, and I’ll send you the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — send me the details when you have them, and I’ll invite a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and we’re ready to start collecting items. Do you want to help me sort donations or make the pickup list?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the pickup list. Send me the details and I’ll start sorting them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Leo — I’ll send you the details now, and you can start sorting the pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what the repair drive needs, so I can check the details first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m a bit behind on the details, but I can help check what they need. I’ll take a look and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll wait for your update before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup if that makes the repair drive easier. What time window are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would help a lot—thank you. I’m thinking the repair drive can run from about 9 to 11, so it shouldn’t clash with drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can help around drop-off and then again after pickup if needed. Just let me know what you need me to bring or cover.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the word on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s moving along nicely—folks have been pitching in, and we’re getting closer to covering the key repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s great to hear. I’m glad people are stepping up—what repairs are we closest to covering?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm you can bring a box of gloves and some packing tape, okay?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can bring a box of gloves and some packing tape.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll probably stop by and see what still needs fixing. If you want, I can help with a few things.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be really kind of you, Rey. I might need a hand figuring out what’s left—I keep losing track of it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, we can go through it together and make a quick list. Just tell me where you want to start.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block and let everyone know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll mention it to folks I see and let you know if anyone can help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring my old tools by. If you’re still taking donations, I can drop them off later today.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, please do — we’re still taking donations. I’ll be around later, so just swing by whenever works for you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll swing by later with the tools. Thanks for keeping track of me — I’d forget my own head if it wasn’t attached.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring the drill, a few screws, and a flashlight if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll bring the drill, some screws, and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with that repair drive. What do you need, Eli?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I need help getting the old tools loaded and then we can drop them off after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I can help load the old tools after lunch and we’ll drop them off together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s so kind of you, Mara—could you help spread the word and maybe keep an eye out for anyone who needs pickup or tools?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I can spread the word and keep an eye out for anyone needing pickup or tools. Just send me the details and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be wonderful, Jules — could you let me know which households you reach so I can keep track?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted on each household I reach. I’m starting with the folks on Maple and Cedar tonight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m getting the repair drive organized and should have the first list ready soon. If you know of anyone who needs help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out and send anyone your way who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate that. I’ll share the list as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is happening soon—what do we need to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mostly just the broken item, if you can carry it. If you’ve got any extra screws or the charger, bring those too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I can do that. I’ll bring the broken item and check for any extra screws or the charger.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Can you help sort the donations and load the boxes after school? I’ll send you the timing once I confirm the pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can do that. Send me the time once you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm — you’re really helping with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m really helping with the repair drive. Tell me what you need me to do.
